keyPoints.en: Simple present: habits and facts — The sun rises in the east.
keyPoints.hi: Simple present: आदतें और तथ्य — The sun rises in the east।

keyPoints.en: Present continuous: happening now — She is reading.
keyPoints.hi: Present continuous: अभी हो रहा — She is reading।

keyPoints.en: Past continuous: was/were + -ing; future: will + verb
keyPoints.hi: Past continuous: was/were + -ing; future: will + verb

problem.en: Fill in with "watch": "Look! The children __ a puppet show."
problem.hi: "watch" से भरो: "Look! The children __ a puppet show."

steps.en: "Look!" shows it is happening now → present continuous.
steps.hi: "Look!" बताता है कि अभी हो रहा है → present continuous।

problem.en: Fill in with "sleep": "When the phone rang, I __."
problem.hi: "sleep" से भरो: "When the phone rang, I __."

steps.en: An action going on in the past when another happened → past continuous.
steps.hi: बीते समय में चल रहा काम जब दूसरा हुआ → past continuous।

question.en: Change to future: "We visit our grandparents."
question.hi: Future में बदलो: "We visit our grandparents."

question.en: Fill in with "play": "They __ football at 5 p.m. yesterday."
question.hi: "play" से भरो: "They __ football at 5 p.m. yesterday."

intro.en: Tense shows when an action happens. Each of present, past and future has simple and continuous forms: I play / I am playing; I played / I was playing; I will play / I will be playing.
intro.hi: Tense बताता है कि काम कब होता है। Present, past और future में simple और continuous रूप होते हैं: I play / I am playing; I played / I was playing; I will play / I will be playing।
